fb_text:
Every service company owner has taken this call.

"Your guy was never here."

You know he was. He knows he was. The client doesn't care — no paper trail, no argument won.

I run a commercial plant service company in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties across the metro. After a stop, my tech sends a 10-second voice note like he's texting me. FieldNotes logs the visit with a timestamp, rewrites the note into a clean client-safe recap, and I approve it with a checkmark from my phone. The client gets a professional visit summary by email.

Next time someone says "nobody showed," the reply is a timestamped recap. That conversation is over before it starts.

No apps for the crew. No forms. Just texts.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
